name: 5 Card Slingo
summary: 5 Card Slingo combines the exciting action of Slingo with the challenge of Poker. Each deal turns up five playing cards, which the player places in the columns above them on a 5x5 grid, building the best possible poker hands across rows, columns and diagonals to score points. This interactive television version was distributed on the GSN Game Lounge channel for DirecTV subscribers and is no longer playable.
